correctness.rationale: The upper equations uniquely force b_i=a_(i-1)+a_i+a_(i+1); the lower equations reduce exactly to a_(i+4)=a_i, proving a period-g solution space for every n>=3. The eight odd-weight four-bit coordinate forms constitute an affine three-space, giving RM(1,3) by an explicit coordinate permutation; standard affine codimension bounds prove each generalized weight. Full GF2 matrix elimination checked n=3..64, independent brute-force every subset n=3..9, and independent subspace-support census n=3..24. Finite checks corroborate the symbolic proof, not vice versa.
